title: The Twelve Judges Sent from the Father
description: The Father of Greatness sends forth twelve great mighty judges, each a distinct operation of Divine Truth's discriminating power. Together they perform the whole work of separating light from darkness — from the First Man's humbling and the Living Spirit's response, through the establishment of cosmic governance, the Ambassador's revelation, and the Great Counsel's gathering into the Last Andrias. The twelve all proceed from one hidden Father who himself is the great Judge enthroned as King of Honor.
